scientific.integrity: The primary full text was materially inspected at the exact inequalities and the hole-width extension used by the proof. A same-topic follow-up source independently verifies MSC 52C15. Semantic and formula-fingerprint searches were compared against the final statement. Symbolic computation verifies only the new algebraic specialization; the published annulus theorem is cited as an external premise.
limitations: The displayed delta_N is the largest threshold certified by optimizing White--Wisewell's explicit inequalities on regular even N-gons; true optimality for Bezdek's annulus problem is not claimed.
The new formula covers even N at least six; the square has a prior-known, proof-specific doubled-translation improvement.
The same-orientation homothetic corollary is a special case of the stronger side-normal-width statement.
An unindexed elementary specialization remains a historical originality risk.

title: Optimized annulus protection scale for regular even polygons
